cohort: 50 women with a history of CVT diagnosed in the last 5 years and 100 pregnant women without a history of CVT
finding: More than half of women of childbearing age with a history of CVT opted for pregnancy, with no major additional risk for pre or postpartum complications other than a slightly higher risk of pre-eclampsia and slightly lower gestational age at delivery.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 36.9 weeks in the CVT group and 38.3 weeks in the control group.
